arabic text: YA ZAINAB E KUBRA, YA ZAINAB E KUBRA
english translation text: O ZAINAB E KUBRA, O ZAINAB E KUBRA

arabic text: HUM RANJO MUSEEBAT ME GIRAFTAR HAI BIBI\nKHUD DEKHLO CHEHRE KO AZADAR HAI BIBI\nHO HUMKO ATA HAZRATE SHABBIR KA SADQA
english translation text:
WE ARE SURROUNDED BY TRIALS AND TRIBULATION
SEE FOR YOURSELF O BIBI,
WE ARE YOUR AZADAR,
MAY WE GET GRANTED, FOR THE SAKE OF SHABBIR (A.S.)

arabic text: HAIN JITNEY BHI BEEMAR ATA SAB KO SHIFA HO\nJO BHI HO GIRAFTARE MASAEEB WOH RIHA HO\nHUM SAB KO ZIYARAT KE LIYE SHAAM BULANA
english translation text: MAY THOSE WHO ARE ILL GET CURED,\nMAY THOSE WHO ARE AFFLICTED WITH GRIEF, BE FREE OF THEIR GRIEF,\nCALL US ALL TO THE ZIYARAT OF SHAAM!

arabic text: JO GODIYAN MEHROOM HAI AWLAAD SE\nBIBI HON SAAHIBE AWLAAD BHAREN GODIYAN SAB KI\nHO IN KO ATA ASGHAR E BESHEER KA SADQA
english translation text: THOSE WHO ARE NOT BLESSED WITH CHILDREN, O BIBI, MAY ALL THESE FAMILIES BECOME BLESSED WITH CHILDREN,\nMAY THEY BE GRANTED CHILDREN FOR THE SAKE OF ALI ASGHER

arabic text: ZAAHIR HO JO DUNYA ME RAZA HUJJATE AAKHIR\nTAYAR HON HUM NUSRATE ISLAM KI KHATIR\nHAATHON ME ALAM LAB PE HO LABBAYK KA NARA
english translation text: AS THE AWAITED ONE (ATFS) REAPPEARS, WE SHALL BE READY FOR THE SAKE OF ISLAM,\nWITH AN ‘ALAM’(FLAG) IN OUR HANDS AND LABBAYK ON OUR LIPS (AND HEARTS)
